test_modes.name: Conformance test
test_modes.purpose: FlexRay conformance test suite (ISO 17458-5) validates protocol behavior.

test_modes.name: Loopback / monitoring
test_modes.purpose: CC monitor mode observes the bus without transmitting.

spec_provided_observability.name: POC state (vPOC!State)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: The current Protocol Operation Control state is host-readable for bring-up and fault diagnosis.

spec_provided_observability.name: Cycle / macrotick / slot counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: vCycleCounter (0..63), the macrotick counter, and the slot counter expose the node's position in the schedule.

spec_provided_observability.name: Clock-sync status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Offset/rate correction values and sync-frame counts indicate synchronization health and drive NORMAL_ACTIVE/NORMAL_PASSIVE degradation.

spec_provided_observability.name: Header / Frame CRC error status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CRC error flags identify corrupt frames per channel.

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-channel frame status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Valid/null/sync/startup frame status per slot per channel.

spec_provided_observability.name: Media access Test Symbol (MTS)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Network-management test symbol used to probe media access in the symbol window.

error_detection_mechanisms: Null Frame Indicator distinguishes an application-empty slot from a missing frame.
Dual-channel comparison: a receiver may take a valid frame from either channel.
Clock-sync degradation (too few valid sync frames) trips NORMAL_PASSIVE / HALT.
Bus Guardian blocks out-of-slot transmission (babbling-idiot protection).

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Start of a new communication cycle (cycle counter increment).
A frame is received in a slot on a channel.
NORMAL_ACTIVE <-> NORMAL_PASSIVE transition from clock-sync status.
Bus Driver detects a Wakeup Pattern.
Coldstart succeeds and the node reaches NORMAL_ACTIVE.

notes: FlexRay's protocol-level test surface is the Controller Host Interface status (POC state, counters, clock-sync status, CRC error flags) plus the symbol-window MTS and the conformance test suite. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain CC-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns.
